title: sodium issue #3606: [1.21.1] [NeoForge] All world textures become invisible when Sodium is installed with Create: Aeronautics
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text: [issue by Gavirchik] ### Bug Description ### Problem When installing Create: Aeronautics together with Sodium, **all world textures become completely invisible**. The player inventory and UI elements still render correctly, but blocks, entities, and the entire world are gone. The issue occurs only when both mods are installed together. When Sodium is removed, Aeronautics works fine. When Aeronautics is removed, Sodium works fine. **CRITICAL:** Rolling back Sodium to any version below 0.6.9 is impossible, because **Create 6.0.10 has a hard dependency on Sodium 0.6.9+**. ### Environment - **Minecraft version:** 1.21.1 - **Mod loader:** NeoForge (latest version) - **Sodium version:** 0.6.13 (latest) - **Create version:** 6.0.10 - **Create: Aeronautics version:** latest (1.1.0 and above) - **Sable / Veil:** installed (as dependencies of Aeronautics) **Actual behavior:** The world is completely invisible — only UI and GUI elements (inventory, crosshair, HUD) are visible. ### Workarounds Attempted (that did NOT help) - Added `mixin.features.render.immediate.matrix_stack=false` to `sodium-mixins.properties` (this normally fixes similar issues for Pixelmon and other custom model mods [citation:1][citation:2]) - Disabled other rendering-related mixins (`mixin.features.render.entity=false`, etc.) - Changed graphics settings (Fancy/ Fast/OFF) - Reloaded resources (F3+T) **None of these resolved the issue.** ### Reproduction Steps Reproduction Steps: Install the latest versions of NeoForge 1.21.1. Install Create 6.0.10. Install Create: Aeronautics (latest version). Install Sodium 0.6.9 (NeoForge version). Launch the game and create a new single-player Creative world. Once in the world, take any block from Create: Aeronautics from the creative inventory. Place the block on the ground. Observed: All world textures become invisible, only the HUD/inventory is rendered. ### Log File [latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27023229/latest.log) ### Crash Report [crash-2026-04-23_21.54.02-client.SODIUM-ON.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27023150/crash-2026-04-23_21.54.02-client.SODIUM-ON.txt) [crash-2026-04-23_21.59.05-client.SODIUM-OFF.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27023139/crash-2026-04-23_21.59.05-client.SODIUM-OFF.txt) [comment by jellysquid3 (member)] Can you please provide information about your computer's hardware? The crash report and log file are both unusually vague. [comment by douira (contributor)] Please provide a reproduction with only the mods you've mentioned, and not the many dozens of other mods you're using. [comment by Gavirchik (none)] I have created a clean test instance with only the following mods installed: NeoForge (version 21.1.225) Create (version 6.0.10) Create: Aeronautics (version 1.1.3) + its dependencies (Sable, Veil) Sodium (version 0.6.13) The issue still occurs in this minimal environment. Here is the requested proof: SODIUM ON [crash-2026-04-23_22.33.41-client.SodiumON.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27024576/crash-2026-04-23_22.33.41-client.SodiumON.txt) SODIUM OFF [crash-2026-04-23_22.35.19-client.SodiumOFF.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27024557/crash-2026-04-23_22.35.19-client.SodiumOFF.txt) [latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27024603/latest.log) [comment by douira (contributor)] Related: https://github.com/Creators-of-Aeronautics/Simulated-Project/issues/288 As jellysquid mentioned above, please provide us with hardware information about your system. [comment by Gavirchik (none)] The problem is solved, I have updated the GPU drivers. [comment by douira (contributor)] I'm guessing this is an instance of https://github.com/CaffeineMC/sodium/issues/3318 [comment by DRD2k8 (none)] This issue isn't fixed for me To be honest, I doubt these two mods will ever work together [comment by jellysquid3 (member)] The mods work together fine. The problem is an incompatibility with specific graphics drivers. We can do little about these issues in general.
